fields.description: Program Description 1. Brief Introduction Duration: 4 years This program includes two majors: Chinese Education and Business Chinese. Our goal is: We enhance the professional talents (Chinese teachers, interpreters and specialized commercial personnel) with good Chinese understanding and expression. They can master Chinese knowledge and skills completely, understand the condition and culture of China and use the Chinese language to work freely in certain fields. 2. Courses: The first two years: Elementary and intermediate Chinese, listening and speaking, extensive reading and basic composition, etc. Starting from the third year, three majors are available: Major in Chinese education Advanced Comprehensive Course, Advanced Conversational Chinese, Chinese Composition, Modern Chinese Language, Basic Classical Chinese Language, Chinese Culture, Chinese Newspaper Reading Teaching Methodology of Chinese and other selective courses. Major in Business Chinese Comprehensive Business Chinese, Conversational Business Chinese, Chinese Business Composition, Chinese Business Reading, Economy of Current China, Basic Economics, management, International Trade, and other selective courses. 3. Graduation qualification: a. Getting all the compulsory credits b. Passing the dissertation c. Obtaining Grade A of new HSK level 5

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. TWO Recommendation Letters One is from the principal of high school and one is from the teacher. Applicants with high education should provide 2 recommendation letters from professor or associate professor in the graduated university or college. Original or notarized version, in notarized Chinese or English Translation. * 2. Study Plan An undergraduate study plan, including applicants' understanding of the discipline or major they are applying for and their plan, about 400 words. * 3. Certification of Bank Deposit * 4. A scanned copy of passport valid for more than 6 months. * 5. Single person color photo without a hat, taken recently within the last 6 months (same size as the one on the passport). * 6. High School Graduation Certificate Certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 7. High School transcript Academic Transcripts in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Both original and official English translated version are required. * 8. Certificate of HSK No need for Chinese Language and Literature major. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. - Mathematics is required (Examination language is Chinese) . Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1.Target Group High school qualification or above with valid foreign passport. 2.Special Conditions Following students should meet the conditions set by Document No. 12(2020) of Ministry of Education of the PRC: Students who emigrate from mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and obtain the foreign nationality. Students, whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality and reside abroad, acquire foreign nationality at the time of birth. 3.Age requirement 18-35 years old (Scholarship applicants must meet the age requirements of each program) 4.Physical Condition In good health, meets the health examination standards of applying for a student visa or residence permit in China. 5.Moral cultivation The applicant should be friendly to China, honest, respects the customs of Chinese people and has no records of violation on Chinese law, school rules, public security punishment or crimination. 6.Financial Condition In good financial situation, be able to pay 4 years tuition, accommodation and related daily living expenses. 7. Valid HSK test report (HSK-4 with a passing score of 180 or above) 8. College Entrance Achievement Test for International Students (CSCA Test), Mathematics is required (Examination language is Chinese).
